_comment: Catalogue for the public hub. Must list exactly the deploy:true games in games/registry.json (checked by `npm run build:hub`). `thumb` is a repo-relative path to the game's own SVG thumbnail. `_review` lists Pidgin lines a human should check.

description.en: Ride the BRT up the ladders, dodge the go-slow, and race the CPU to square 100.
description.pcm: Enter BRT climb ladder, avoid go-slow, and run reach square 100 before di CPU.

description.en: Roll the die, race your seeds home and send rivals back to the yard.
description.pcm: Roll di die, run your seeds go house, and send person back to yard.

description.en: The classic seed-sowing board game. Sow, capture pits and outthink the CPU.
description.pcm: Di old-school ayo game. Drop seeds, carry pits, and use sense beat di CPU.

description.en: Match by shape or number, call your shape and empty your hand first.
description.pcm: Match shape or number, call your shape, make your hand empty first.

description.en: Quiz night, Naija style. Test what you know against the clock and a CPU rival.
description.pcm: Quiz night, correct Naija style. Show wetin you sabi against di clock and di CPU.

description.en: Swipe across the letters to find hidden Naija words before time runs out.
description.pcm: Swipe for di letters find hidden Naija words before time finish.

description.en: Classic draughts against the CPU. Think ahead and capture the most pieces.
description.pcm: Classic draughts against di CPU. Think far and chop di most pieces.
